completion_data.completion_summary: Reconciled lean-lsp MCP registration to the sanctioned wrapper-free uvx+LEAN_PROJECT_PATH shape: repaired setup-lean-mcp.sh and verify-lean-mcp.sh so they can detect/repair command-shape drift (not just project-path drift) and support lakefile.toml projects, recorded the durable no-command-paths-inside-.claude/ invariant, reconciled the live global ~/.claude.json entry, retired cslib's orphaned wrapper and project-scoped override, and proved lean-lsp spawns with a real tool call from fresh sessions in both ~/Projects/BimodalLogic and ~/Projects/cslib. The global LEAN_PROJECT_PATH is currently left pointing at ~/Projects/cslib (the last-verified project); switching to another Lean project requires re-running setup-lean-mcp.sh from that project's directory.

memory_candidates.content: Config-reconciliation script pattern (generalized from the lean-lsp MCP registration repair): when a setup/reconcile script both GENERATES a canonical config object and CHECKS an existing one for 'already configured', the idempotency check must compare the WHOLE generated shape via deep equality (e.g. `jq -n --argjson a "$existing" --argjson b "$canonical" '$a == $b'`, order-independent) and the repair path must overwrite the WHOLE object in one jq assignment -- never a single targeted field. A field-only check can report 'already configured correctly' and exit 0 while other fields (e.g. command/args) are silently broken. Apply the identical fix to any paired verifier: severities must reflect what actually breaks the thing being verified (an unspawnable command is FAIL, not WARN), or wiring that verifier into automated drift detection catches nothing.

A `mcpServers` entry's `command` path must never resolve inside any repository's own `.claude/` deploy tree, because that tree is disposable and wholesale-regenerated (rules/source-store-deploy-boundary.md). A command pointed there looks valid until the next regeneration or fresh clone, then fails as a silent ENOENT with no indication the registered path itself was the defect. Verify this by shape (does command/args resolve inside any .claude/ directory?), not just by whether required env vars are present -- a registration can be 'complete' by field-presence checks while still being unspawnable.
